answer: The river here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Empanelled pearl diver buoy licence is the proof, because a licence divers carry after shell audits. Each name is charged 13 letters of reference, each one priced at £14, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. A farm that mints names by the dozen still pays the toll name by name, and the river proves it. Every ivory is counted once. The meadow is checked, not assumed.
